name: are-you-there
description: Lets Claude Code know whether you're at the terminal, elsewhere on the computer, or away. When you're away, its questions go to your phone and you answer with a tap. 让 Claude Code 知道你在不在终端前；你不在时，问题推到手机上，点一下就能答。

language.title: Language / 语言
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting and your system locale. auto 跟随 Claude Code 的语言设置和系统语言。 [auto | en | zh]

ntfy_topic.title: ntfy topic
ntfy_topic.description: A private, hard-to-guess topic you subscribe to in the ntfy app. Run /are-you-there:setup to generate one. 在 ntfy App 里订阅的私有 topic，名字要难猜；/are-you-there:setup 可以帮你生成。

ntfy_server.title: ntfy server
ntfy_server.description: Leave as https://ntfy.sh unless you self-host. 不自建就保持 https://ntfy.sh。

ntfy_token.title: ntfy access token (optional)
ntfy_token.description: Only for servers that require auth. 只有服务器要求鉴权时才填。

relay_server.title: Answer relay server (optional)
relay_server.description: Defaults to ntfy_server. 手机答案和电脑确认使用的中继，留空时使用 ntfy_server。

relay_token.title: Answer relay access token (optional)
relay_token.description: Configure separately for authenticated relays; never sent in phone links. 鉴权中继需单独配置，不再复用 ntfy_token，不随手机链接发送。

bark_url.title: Bark URL (iOS, optional)
bark_url.description: Your Bark push URL, like https://api.day.app/YOUR_KEY. Bark 推送地址，形如 https://api.day.app/你的key。

webhook_url.title: Webhook URL (optional)
webhook_url.description: Slack, Discord, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, ServerChan, or any URL that accepts a JSON POST. 飞书、钉钉、企业微信、Server 酱等机器人地址，或任何接受 JSON POST 的地址。

webhook_format.title: Webhook format
webhook_format.description: Message shape for the webhook. 机器人消息格式。 [json | slack | discord | feishu | dingtalk | wecom | serverchan]

away_minutes.title: Away after (minutes)
away_minutes.description: No keyboard or mouse input this long while another app has focus means you're away. 焦点不在终端、键鼠闲置多久算离开。

answer_timeout_minutes.title: Wait for a phone answer (minutes)
answer_timeout_minutes.description: How long a question waits for your answer from the phone. 问题在手机上等你回答多久。

when_no_answer.title: When nobody answers
when_no_answer.description: After successful delivery and a healthy timeout, ask waits in the terminal; decide lets Claude pick a reversible option. Delivery/relay failures always return to the terminal. 仅送达后正常超时才可 decide；发送或中继故障一律回终端。 [ask | decide]
